guard: A workflow driver has no cross-run broker authority. Host operations check the current journal, reject copied foreign tokens and forged receipts, and preserve parent-owned cancellation cleanup. Every channel effect is checked against the run's admitted ceiling and current revocation state, re-read leader-served each time.
